diagnostic_ratios.why_not_authorized: The scopes are reported to expose the performance envelope, but author internal AvgTime, author process wall, RTDL route wall, and RTDL full app total are different denominators.

author_internal_avg_time_sec.description: author JSON Running.AvgTime converted from ms; internal reported algorithm time

author_process_wall_sec.description: wall time to invoke author hd_exec once for each case

rtdl_author_abs_diff.description: absolute HDResult difference between RTDL route and author rerun

rtdl_full_total_sec.description: RTDL app gate per-case total including input load/normalization and route

rtdl_route_wall_sec.description: RTDL route phase from the app runner, excluding input loading and author invocation

total_points.description: sum of input point counts for the pair
